syllabus_topics: Unix programming environment: gcc, gdb, cvs, make, lex and yacc tools
Regular languages and lexical analysis: modeling sentence recognition with finite automata (non-deterministic and deterministic)
Context free languages: context free grammars, derivation trees, stack finite automata, descendent parsers LL(1) and bottom-up parsers LR(0)/ SLR(1) / LALR(1)
Error treatment and recovery, semantic analysis
Intermediate code generation of abstract trees and postfix code
Topics of final code generation and optimization for "load and store" machines
assessment_rules: For normal examination period, the final grade is calculated as 50% from the project and 50% from exercises. A minimum grade of 9.5 is required for both components and for the final grade. All project deliveries and the practical test are mandatory. For special examination periods, different scenarios apply based on previous project or lab approval, but generally, both project and exercises are weighted at 50% each with a minimum grade of 9.5.
